verses: Kiya hai woh kharkhara denay wali
Tujhay kiya maloom kay woh khar khara denay wali kiya hai
Jiss din insan bikhray huye perwanon ki tarah ho jayen gay
Aur pahar dhunay huye rangeen oon ki tarah ho jayen gay
Phir jiss kay palry bhari hun gay
Woh to dil pasand aaram ki zindagi mein hoga
Aur jiss kay palry halkay hun gay
Tujhay kiya maloom kay woh kiya hai
